title: Valesong - a new 4-player free-for-all Fantasy CCG
author: Every-Chemistry-1726
selftext:
Hello Everyone, Today we're proud to announce Valesong, our brand new 4-player fantasy ccg. If you're a fan of Magic the Gathering: Commander Format and Hearthstone our game is a mix of the two. It was also made with AI. You can find out a lot more here including how we made the game at [https://www.valesong.com](https://www.valesong.com) \- It launches as a Discord Activity on October 29,2026.

Creating the game has been a true joy - every step of the way we used AI including the card art, AI coding (not going to say AI assisted coding because it was all done using AI). I've been a game maker now for 38 years and the incredible power of AI gave us the ability to move so quickly that we have been able to hone the game because the iteration speed is just insane. I'm happy to answer any questions about how we made it.

Thanks

John Smedley, CEO - Distinct Possibility Studios
